subject: [blast-28] Register for GSBGEN 312: I'm Just a Bill (IJAB)
body:
Are you looking for a Winter class that's unlike anything else at the GSB -
*immersive*, *transformational*, *fun*? Check out GSBGEN 312: *I'm Just a Bill (IJAB) *with Professor KH (Tue/Fri 8:00–9:45 AM).

For the quarter, you'll play a member of Congress (*or President* 👀) with your own party, state, committees, and secret policy goals. Together with ~60 classmates, you'll elect a President, form caucuses, cut deals, and pass (or kill) bills on economics, foreign policy, and AI.

*What you should know:*• No policy background needed. It's built for people from finance, tech, startups, medicine, the military, and everywhere else.
• It's a sandbox for negotiation, persuasion, public speaking, and leading peers.
• You choose your workload: volunteer for a leadership role or request a rank-and-file seat.
• You'll get to know people across the GSB as you build coalitions to achieve your goals.

*Attached *you'll find more information from Professor H. and photos from past years.

Questions? Just reply, or reach out to any of us (including Professor H.) [link].

J., R., and T.
IJAB TAs

*Blast tax: *Don't take our word for it, hear from GSB's most famous influencer [link] - CL!

--
*TSJ*
*STANFORD GRADUATE SCHOOL OF BUSINESS*
MA in Education and MBA Candidate, Class of 2026

body:

*One day left to sign up for a Personal Leadership Coach (PLC)!*

Get the chance to work with an Arbuckle Leadership Fellow through 7 one-on-one coaching sessions to help you navigate the GSB, make sense of feedback, and grow as a leader. It's a great opportunity to have someone in your corner as you figure out what you want from your time here!

Already signed up? If you receive a calendar invite for the Oct. 29 kickoff by midnight tonight, you're all set! No need to apply again. If you don't see an invite yet, please check your spam folder too.
